dialogues.speaker: Takeshi
dialogues.text: Generally speaking, we are the Almighty Shogun's bodyguards.

dialogues.speaker: Takeshi
dialogues.text: The reason for our existence is to make sure that the Almighty Shogun will always have a force by her side that she can always trust and deploy.

dialogues.speaker: Takeshi
dialogues.text: Loyalty is of the utmost importance here.
